source_refs.note: 2- Control Centre: a main subheading of 13.1.1 Basic Mechanism of Homeostasis, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 2-2.

blocks.text: Control centre receptors se khabar leta hai, us par ghaur (process) karta hai, aur effectors ko munasib paigham bhejta hai. In paighamaat se andar ka mahol set points ke aas paas ek tang had (narrow range) mein rehta hai. Set point woh qeemat hai jo jism ke kaam ke liye sab se behtar (optimal) hai, maslan darja-e-hararat ka set point 37°C. Homeostasis mein dimagh (brain), spinal cord aur endocrine glands (hormone banane wale ghadood) control centre ka kaam karte hain.
